nat.start.title: Start
nat.start.intro1: AnimeUp analyses each video you add, helps you pick an upscaling model by eye, then upscales
nat.start.intro2: the whole batch on this Mac, offline. Everything set here can be changed later in Settings (⌘,).
nat.add.title: Add videos
nat.add.not_handled: Not handled: interlaced or telecined video. AnimeUp says so when a file is one.
nat.add.received.uno: {n} video received: the Queue arrives in a later build.
nat.add.received.altri: {n} videos received: the Queue arrives in a later build.
nat.where.title: Where files go
nat.where.or_pick: Or pick a folder for this batch.
nat.where.space_note: If a job would go past it, AnimeUp waits before starting the next file.
nat.where.pick_work: Choose the folder for work files
nat.where.unreachable: The disk with this folder isn't connected.
nat.mac.title: This Mac
nat.mac.first_text: About 10 minutes with the GPU idle, so every estimate matches this Mac.
nat.mac.old_text: Run it again so the estimates for large files are right.
nat.mac.other_text: The calibration on file comes from {chip}. Run it here so every estimate matches this Mac.
nat.tool.unverified: Not the verified build: it comes from {path}.
nat.how.title: How a batch goes
nat.how.cal_text:
Once, about 10 minutes with the GPU idle.
Every time estimate comes from it.
nat.how.add_text:
Each file is analysed as it arrives in the Queue:
timing, tracks and anything worth a warning.
nat.how.compare_text:
Render tricky clips with each model
and pick the one you like by eye.
nat.how.queue_text:
Start the batch, follow it, stop and resume.
Audio, subtitles and chapters carry over.
nat.compare.later: Testing models on clips arrives in a later build.
nat.queue.later: The Queue arrives in a later build.
nat.settings.title: Settings
nat.settings.later: The full Settings window arrives in a later build.
nat.engine.first: First launch: setting up Python and the engine (only once, needs the Internet).
nat.engine.gave_up: The engine stopped several times in a row. Its log says why.
nat.files.missing_file: The file is no longer where it was added from.
nat.alert.novideos_text: AnimeUp looked for .mkv, .mp4 and the other supported formats and found none.
nat.alert.notwritable_text:
macOS doesn’t allow changes in this folder.
Pick another one, or check its permissions in the Finder (Get Info).
nat.alert.inside_title: Work files need a folder of their own
nat.alert.inside_text:
“{folder}” is inside the folder of the finished videos.
Pick one outside it, so cleaning up never touches a finished video.
nat.alert.after_text:
The queue is using the work folder right now.
Change it when the queue finishes, or after Stop All.
nat.open.subfolders_note: A folder brings in every video inside it, subfolders too. Also for dropped folders.
nat.panel.processing_later: How this file will be processed, chunk by chunk, comes with the next milestone (plans and estimates).
nat.panel.waiting: Waiting for its turn: files are analysed one at a time.
nat.panel.analysing_note: Reading the file takes a second; checking the fields and measuring the repeated frames take longer ({elapsed} so far). The model and the estimate follow.
nat.panel.dedup_short_help: The file is too short for a sample of the repeated frames: the estimate uses similar files.
nat.queue.intro1: Every video is analysed as it arrives. Tick the files, check each model, then start:
nat.queue.intro2: open a row for its analysis report or for how it will be processed, chunk by chunk.
nat.queue.models_later: Models and time estimates come with the next milestone.
nat.queue.estimate_note: The actual time depends on how many repeated frames are found
nat.queue.start_later: Processing from the app arrives in a later milestone.
nat.set.language_desc: Starts in the language of macOS; English if it isn’t one of these. Changes right away.
nat.set.notifications_desc: Banners in the top-right corner of the screen: file done, queue finished, problems.
nat.set.pause_desc: Lets the Mac cool down in long queues.
nat.set.locked_text: The queue keeps the values it started with. Change them when it finishes, or after Stop All.
nat.set.height_desc: Default for new files; each file can change it in its processing options.
nat.set.dedup_desc: Speeds up processing: animation often holds the same drawing for 2–3 frames; each is upscaled once and reused.
nat.set.deep_desc: Measures the repeated frames of every file as it arrives. Off: each file gets a Deep Analysis button.
nat.set.force_desc: Processes files even below 1.25× their height, where upscaling adds little.
nat.set.applies: Applies to every new file. The model is picked per file.
nat.set.cal_old_text: v2.0 times the models differently, so the estimates may drift. Calibrate again when the GPU is free.
nat.set.cal_other_title: These numbers come from another Mac.
nat.set.cal_other_text: The settings folder was copied from {chip}. Until this Mac is calibrated, every estimate is off.
nat.set.cal_foot: About 10 minutes with the GPU idle. Every time estimate in AnimeUp comes from these numbers; recalibrate after a macOS update or if estimates drift. Calibrating opens in the main window.
nat.set.finished_desc: Used for new batches. You can pick another folder each time you start one.
nat.set.work_desc: Heavy while a job runs: an external disk is fine.
nat.set.space_desc: The most one file may use while processed. More space, fewer chunks, a bit faster; ~50 GB minimum at 1080p. If the disk has less free, AnimeUp lowers it for that job and says so.
nat.set.after_desc: The log is always kept, next to the finished video.
nat.set.after_delete: Delete work files, keep the log
nat.set.keep_title: Each file can leave tens of GB.
nat.set.keep_text: Work files stay in the folder until you discard them from the file list.
nat.set.auto_check_desc: Once a day, in the background.
nat.set.auto_install_desc: Never while a job runs: it waits for the queue to finish.
nat.set.up_to_date: AnimeUp v{version} is up to date
nat.side.usable_meanwhile: Compare and the other files are usable meanwhile.
nat.start.click_report: Click a file to open its analysis report in the Queue.
nat.start.drop_more: Drop more videos or folders here, or
nat.start.all_analysed_warn: All analysed: some files have something worth a look.
nat.tools.intro1: Before the first video, AnimeUp needs its tools: about {mb} MB,
nat.tools.intro2: downloaded once, each one checked against its published checksum.
nat.tools.inside: The tools stay inside AnimeUp; nothing else is installed on the Mac.
nat.tools.stopped_text: Something went wrong while {tool} was downloading.
nat.tools.stopped_kept: What’s already done is kept: Try Again picks up from there.
nat.queue.range: Between {best} and {worst}, depending on the repeated frames found.
nat.queue.estimate_help: The sum of the ticked files' estimates.
nat.queue.factory_note: factory estimates: calibrate this Mac for exact ones
nat.plan.name: Name
